entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: The parser rejects bool on every non-comparison binary operator, including or. Every caller forwards the inner or BinaryExpr recognized by mixedExpHistogramSetOp, never an enclosing comparison node. The shared math adapter lowerMathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp likewise passes that same recognized union through its policy-authorized loader; it does not synthesize an AST node or copy an outer ReturnBool flag. Replacing the three math builders with one adapter therefore changes the caller inventory but cannot make b.ReturnBool true for a parsed union.
